programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Linus Torvalds: The mind behind Linux
programme.desc: Linus Torvalds transformed technology twice — first with the Linux kernel, which helps power the Internet, and again with Git, the source code management system used by developers worldwide. In a rare interview with TED Curator Chris Anderson, Torvalds discusses with remarkable openness the personality traits that prompted his unique philosophy of work, engineering and life. "I am not a visionary, I'm an engineer," Torvalds says. "I'm perfectly happy with all the people who are walking around and just staring at the clouds ... but I'm looking at the ground, and I want to fix the pothole that's right in front of me before I fall in."TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Mathias Jud: Art that lets you talk back to NSA spies
programme.desc: In 2013, the world learned that the NSA and its UK equivalent, GCHQ, routinely spied on the German government. Amid the outrage, artists Mathias Jud and Christoph Wachter thought: Well, if they're listening ... let's talk to them. With antennas mounted on the roof of the Swiss Embassy in Berlin's government district, they set up an open network that let the world send messages to US and UK spies listening nearby. It's one of three bold, often funny, and frankly subversive works detailed in this talk, which highlights the world's growing discontent with surveillance and closed networks.TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: The Curse of Civil War Gold
programme.desc: Teamet avdekker beviser for en hemmelig tunnel, og nye ledetråder peker på et større mysterium enn det savnede konføderasjonsgullet.

programme.title: The Universe
programme.desc: Universet vårt består av energi, fra relativistisk jet fra sorte hull til rå atomkraft hos sola vår. Den totale mengden energi i universet er konstant. Det kan ikke legges til mer eller fjernes noe.

programme.title: Warriors
programme.desc: Reis jorda rundt sammen med den moderne krigeren Terry Schappert. Her lærer du om kulturen til noen av verdens mest berømte krigere og blir kjent med våpnene, taktikkene og psyken deres.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Vi gleder oss til at astronauter lander på Mars innenfor 20 år, men finnes det bevis for at de første frøene til menneskeliv oppsto der?

programme.title: Unidentified: Inside America's UFO Investigation
programme.desc: I 2017 bidro Tom Delonge og Lue Elizondo til å få frigitt tre videoer fra amerikanske jagerflypiloter av "Tic Tac"-UFO-er. Disse videoene fikk marinen til å innrømme at de uidentifiserte farkostene faktisk eksisterer.

programme.title: UFO Hunters
programme.desc: I 2008 offentliggjorde Storbritannias utenriksdepartement hemmelige ufo-saker fra flere tiår for allmennheten. En måned senere ble landet herjet av ufo-hysteri.

programme.title: UFO Files
programme.desc: Dykk inn i kjølvannet og konsekvensene av Roswell-hendelsen i 1947, hvor mange mennesker trodde at et romfartøy hadde krasjet i New Mexico.

programme.title: Lost Gold of World War II
programme.desc: Peter møter en mann som advarer om farene ved å lete etter Yamashitas skatt og undersøke koblingen til CIA. Teamet gjør alt de kan for å fjerne de siste hindringene, og de finner en hemmelig tunnel som går inn i fjellet.

programme.title: Lost Gold of World War II
programme.desc: Den amerikanske skattejegeren John Casey drar tilbake til Filippinene med et nytt team og ny teknologi for å løse en av de største mysteriene fra 2. verdenskrig. Satellittskanning av fjellet viser at det finnes store mengder metall under bakken.

programme.title: The Curse of Civil War Gold
programme.desc: De får bare en sjanse til å overbevise Marty om å bli med på jakten, så teamet drar vestover for å avsløre flere spor.

programme.title: The Universe
programme.desc: Planeter med ringer er vakre, dødelige og fulle av overraskelser. Saturns fascinerende ringer har interessert mange forskere gjennom århundrene.

programme.title: Warriors
programme.desc: Japan, 1612: Den legendariske samuraien Musashi møter erkerivalen Kojiro i en kulminerende duell. Den moderne tids kriger Terry Schappert går på innsiden av noen av tidenes mest berømte krigerkulturer for å utforske deres våpen, taktikker og psyke.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Ancient astronaut-teorier hevder at romvesen har veiledet menneskeheten i skjul for å gi oss store teknologiske framskritt.

programme.title: Lost Worlds
programme.desc: Et team med etterforskere avslører hemmeligheter som kan gjenskape forsvunne og skjulte verdener. De bruker moderne forskning, ekspertanalyser og avansert grafisk teknologi i arbeidet.

programme.title: De største Imperiene: Slik ble de bygget
programme.desc: Etter Romerrikets fall oppsto det autonome bystater som ble bygd med radikal design. Se hvordan et nytt Italia ble til.

programme.title: River Hunters
programme.desc: Programleder Rick Edwards og elvedetektoristen Beau Ouimette er i Nord-Wales for å undersøke vannveier som kan inneholde spor etter det walisiske opprøret i middelalderen.

programme.desc: Nye beviser tyder på at det kan finnes et stort skattkammer under en foss. John vil finne en vei inn, men naturen gjør det ikke lett for ham. Samtidig samles teamet i Breach 6 etter at man har funnet et nytt spor.

programme.title: Elefanthistorier
programme.desc: Følg eventyrene til tre elefanter i tre særegne habitater i Afrika. Sammen forteller de historien om hvordan disse emosjonelle og intelligente dyrene har utviklet seg gjennom millioner av år for å overleve på dette kontinentet.

programme.title: NATURE
programme.desc: Fordyp deg i de intrikate livene til tuskers med Craig, Pascal og Esau, tre afrikanske hann-elefanter i alle livets stadier. Få et sjeldent innblikk i det subtile språket, kompleks samhandling og dype bånd hos verdens største pattedyr på land.

programme.title: Et år i det ville Afrika
programme.desc: I Sør-Afrika begynner våren tidlig i september, og naturen våkner til live. Dagene blir lengre, temperaturen stiger, og dyr og planter kommer sammen i et forsøk på å formere seg, føde og oppdra unger.

programme.title: Et år i det ville Afrika
programme.desc: Sommeren i Afrika er en årstid full av ytterligheter som skiller klinten fra hveten. Den tester overlevelsesinstinktene til geparder, løver, gekkoer, skilpadder og mange flere arter på leting etter mat og vann i den ekstreme sommerheten.

programme.title: Et år i det ville Afrika
programme.desc: Den afrikanske høsten fører med seg nye muligheter. Sørafrikanske pelsseler, blåaper, kameleoner, impalaer og mange flere tilpasser seg årstiden. Høsten betyr endringer i livet til mange dyr. Sjeldne dyr viser seg, og rovdyr samles for å utnytte dette.

programme.title: Et år i det ville Afrika
programme.desc: Bli vitne til den død og gjenoppstandelse som vinteren i Afrika fører med seg. Se hva som kommer med kortere dager, fra tørke til iskalde vinder, og la deg imponere av overlevelsesferdighetene til dyr og planter som står overfor årstidens vrede.

programme.title: Hvordan villdyrene sover
programme.desc: Få mer kunnskap om et av de minst forståtte områdene innen dyrevitenskap: søvn. Se på tilpasninger som har blitt gjort av de mest ekstreme soverne på Jorden, fra små bier som sover 20 timer om dagen til elefanter som overlever på to timer med hvile.

programme.title: Dyrevern i byen
programme.desc: Sentrets kalkunkondor er klar til å slippes fri, og leter etter en flokk. Nathalie og teamet hennes prøver å skaffe finansiering til et nytt anlegg, og det medisinske teamet blir forvirret av en padde som har blitt syk på mystisk vis.

programme.title: Australske slangetemmere: Livsfarlig forfølgelse
programme.desc: Rot deg bort i parringssesongen med Mick og Adele, som redder en jack Russell fra en sulten pyton. Plask rundt med Mick når han omringer en livsfarlig rødbuket svartslange i et basseng, og håndter østlige brunsnoker på en byggeplass med Stu og Liv.

programme.title: Australske slangetemmere: Livsfarlig forfølgelse
programme.desc: Gjør deg klar klar for en het redningsaksjon når Dan og Jess fjerner parrende østlige brunsnoker fra en bakgård. Hold pusten når Mick snuser seg frem til en svært giftig slange inni en sofapute, og se Stu rive et hønsehus for å få ut en teppepyton.

programme.title: Australske slangetemmere: Livsfarlig forfølgelse
programme.desc: Dra til et resort der Stu og Liv prøver å fange en gravid rødbuket svartslange foran turister. Se Mick og Adele få tak i en spraglevaran som jager høns til middag. Fang deretter en sleip garasjeinntrenger med Jess og Dan.

programme.title: Australske slangetemmere: Livsfarlig forfølgelse
programme.desc: Bli skitten med Stu og Liv, som prøver å være smartere enn en blåtungeskink. Kjemp mot tiden med Jess og Dan når de prøver å redde en gravid slange før den blir til mange flere, og se Mick og Adele holde en pyton unna to lekne hundevalper.

programme.title: Vill vitenskap
programme.desc: Få et gjensyn med brunbjørnens evolusjonære reise, fra dens forfedre som dominerte under istiden til dagens moderne altetere. Vær vitne til deres symbiotiske forhold til laks og de overraskende sammenflettede økosystemene de lever i.

programme.title: Koalaenes hemmelige liv
programme.desc: Til tross for at koalaen er et av de mest kjente pungdyrene i Australia, lever den bare i de østre og sørøstre delene av landet. Se hvordan koalaenes liv og adferd varierer mellom de ulike regionene.

programme.title: Koalaenes hemmelige liv
programme.desc: Koalaene virker kanskje isolerte og dorske, men under paringstiden gjennomgår adferden deres en dramatisk forvandling som fører til forflytninger, kontakt og konflikt. Følg to store hanner som er ute etter å finne seg make når paringstiden begynner.

programme.title: Dyrenes imperier

programme.title: Kampen om herredømme
programme.desc: Hold deg unna disse alfadyrene, med horn, klør og annet beskyttelsesutstyr som gjør at de er klare til kamp, uansett hva været har å by på. Se nærmere på de livsfarlige hornene til høylandsfe, nebbet til modige stokkender, de sylskarpe klørne til jerv med mer.

programme.title: Koalaenes hemmelige liv

programme.title: Vill vitenskap
programme.desc: Følg reisen til det svarte neshornet og se hvordan tilpasning og bevaring har påvirket utviklingen til en eldgammel naturens titan. Opplev denne rustningkledde planteeterens utrolige hørsel, luktesans og andre biologiske fortrinn.

programme.title: Utemmede Filippinene
programme.desc: Opplev de sammenviklede livene til ville dyr påvirket av vulkaner, skog og sjø. Fly en tur med sjeldne apeørner mens de oppdrar ungene sine i et eldgammelt tre, for så å dykke ned i elven for å få et glimt av verdens sjeldneste krokodille.

programme.title: Utemmede Filippinene
programme.desc: Kast det ut i det krystallklare havet for å utforske Tubbataha-revet, som hviler på en inaktiv undervannsvulkan der grunne laguner gir beskyttelse for havskilpadder og tigerhaier. Kom deg opp i trærne med spøkelsesaper når de jakter insekter.

programme.title: Dyrenes imperier
programme.desc: Gjennom tidene har mange arter vært truet av utryddelse. Dyreriker som en gang var mektige, f.eks. dinosaurene, er fullstendig utslettet. Men andre på randen av å bli borte, har overlevd, reist seg igjen og til og med tatt tilbake rikene sine.

programme.title: Den levende stranden
programme.desc: Den står på UNESCOS verdensarvliste, er verdens største sandøy, og her finner vi ville dingoer, seks fot lange sandormer og eukalyptusskoger. Se hvordan alt lever fornøyd sammen i et avansert økosystem som er bygget på sand.

programme.title: Claudio Abbado & Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra - Mozart - Symphony No. 35, K. 385
programme.desc: Claudio Abbado conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Mozart’s “Haffner” Symphony No. 35, K. 385, recorded during the very first Europakonzert in the Smetana Hall in Prague, 1991. Mozart originally composed the symphony as a serenade for the family of Sigmund Haffner, a childhood friend from Salzburg in 1782. The composer made some revisions in the following year, adding multiple instruments and conducted the premiere of the four-movement piece on March 23, 1783, in Vienna. The “Haffner” Symphony, as it is known now, is a transitional work in Mozart’s career. The work was meant to be party music for Salzburg and was transformed into a symphony for Vienna.

programme.title: Photo Contest

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of an Italian painter, Raphaël. You will discover his labour with Spozalizio, The virgin and child with St John the Baptist or portrait of Baldassare Castiglione.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Franco-Danish painter, Camille Pissarro. You will discover his labour with View from Louveciennes, A path through the fields, Pontoise or Peasant girl making a fire.

programme.title: Video Art
programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: John Singer Sargent: Fashion and Swagger
programme.desc: John Singer Sargent is known as the greatest portrait artist of his era. What made his ‘swagger’ portraits remarkable was his power over his sitters, what they wore and how they were presented to the audience. Through interviews with curators, contemporary fashionistas and style influencers, Exhibition on Screen’s film will examine how Sargent’s unique practice has influenced modern art, culture and fashion.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Genre pictural existant depuis l’Antiquité, la nature morte connut un regain d’intérêt à partir du XVIIe siècle dans la peinture européenne. Représentation composée d’éléments inanimés, elle peut se limiter à la table d’un repas, comme dans le frugal Dessert de gaufrettes de Lubin Baugin, ou d’animaux chassés comme dans la Nature morte au faisan de Jean-Baptiste Oudry. Retrouvez également des natures mortes célèbres de Chardin, Cézanne et Van Gogh.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: La Prison de la Santé, construite à Paris entre 1861 et 1867, est un ensemble architectural unique, homogène, imposant. À la pointe de la réflexion théorique sur l’enfermement, elle fut à son époque la "prison moderne" par excellence, la traduction en pierre des nouvelles obsessions pénitentiaires du XIXème siècle : la prison panoptique, la rationalisation et l’humanisation de la détention, la rédemption du détenu.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: En 2013, la Norvège célébra le 150e anniversaire de la naissance d'Edvard Munch (1863-1944), l'une des figures proéminentes de l'art moderne. Munch 150, coproduite par le Musée national et le Musée Munch, est déjà acclamée comme « l'exposition d'une vie ». L'intérêt général est énorme, comme le témoigne le résultat record de la mise aux enchères publiques de l'un de ses quatre tableaux, Le Cri, soit 120 millions de dollars. Cette présentation vous amènera dans les coulisses de la mise en place de cette exposition, en plus de comprendre une visite guidée de la Norvège qui brossera la biographie de cet homme dont la vie s'est étalée de la moitié du 19ème siècle jusqu'à l'occupation allemande lors de la Seconde Guerre mondiale.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Degas : une passion de la perfection
programme.desc: Exhibition on screen nous emmène à travers les rues de Paris puis au cœur d’une superbe exposition au Fitzwilliam Museum de Cambridge, dont l’impressionnante collection d’œuvres de Degas est la plus représentative de Grande-Bretagne. Ayant bénéficié d’un accès exclusif à une grande variété d’œuvres rares, le film raconte l’histoire fascinante de la quête de perfection de Degas à travers l’expérimentation de nouvelles techniques et les leçons apprises en étudiant les grands maîtres.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, (1525-1569) is one of the most renowned Flemish painters of the Renaissance. Although influenced by Italian art, his paintings maintained a typically Flemish tradition. A “peasant” painter, he depicted the lives of his country’s common folk as in the “Peasant Wedding”. In “Netherlandish Proverbs”, he wittily transcribes dozens of popular sayings. Admire also his incomplete “Tower of Babel”, a theme which Bruegel made into his own speciality.Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: In this episode we will decipher the most famous works of Johannes Vermeer. He was born in 1632 and lived his whole life in Delft. He painted mainly interior scenes, everyday life with middle-class people but also with servants. He is the author of "The Milkmaid

programme.title: Graffiti World
programme.desc: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

Peter detours to learn how hockey became a popular sport the world over while keen aviator Sarah sees how the Battle of Britain was won. programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip

Cyrus démontre un talent certain pour négocier, tandis que Tony n’hésite pas à afficher ses prix.Tony découvre pourquoi une ville écossaise a été le foyer de nombreux millionnaires, et Cyrus prend ses marques en mer en apprenant pourquoi Anstruther était un port de pêche clé au XIXe siècle.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Matisse au MoMA et à la Tate Modern
programme.desc: Découvrez l’œuvre de Matisse à travers les expositions de la Tate Modern à Londres et du MoMA de New York (2014) et profitez de la performance originale de la danseuse étoile du Royal Ballet Zenaida Yanowsky, qui interprète les couleurs et le dynamisme de la peinture de Matisse sur la musique jazz de Courtney Pine. Ponctué d’entrevues avec des experts ainsi que d’images d’archives rares de Matisse au travail, ce documentaire permettra d’apprécier tout particulièrement le dernier chapitre de la carrière du peintre et notamment ses gouaches découpées.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Le collectionneur danois : de Delacroix à Gauguin
programme.desc: Wilhelm Hansen fut un homme d’affaires visionnaire, qui vécut au Danemark au XIXème siècle. Il fut l’un des rares collectionneurs à s’intéresser aux peintres impressionnistes, à une époque où ils étaient attaqués et dénigrés. Le film nous amène dans la maison d’été de Hansen dans la banlieue de Copenhague et nous fait visiter l’extraordinaire exposition à la Royal Academy de Londres consacrée à sa collection.

programme.title: Graffiti World
programme.desc: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: The decisive moment
programme.desc: In this episode, we will meet Pierre Morel, a photojournalist. He started this job very young and considers it a way of commitment and activism. What interests him is to have the point of view of several photographers on the society and he tries to give his own point of view in his turn.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les légendes de la scène et de l'écran, Charles Dance et Geraldine James, rejoignent les experts en antiquités Natasha Raskin et Will Axon pour cette excursion dans le Wiltshire.Charles trouve une paire de vases en argent de l'époque édouardienne qu'il espère rentabiliser lors d'une vente aux enchères dans l'Essex. Geraldine, elle, tombe sur un homme dans la rue avec un secrétaire Empire français du XIXe siècle. Il lui en coûte une petite fortune - le pari sera-t-il gagnant ?Charles se retrouve dans le cockpit d'un très vieil hélicoptère tandis que Geraldine apprend comment un petit quartier de Swindon datant de 170 ans a influencé la création du NHS moderne.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les animatrices vedettes Nicki Chapman et Jules Hudson s'échappent à la campagne pour partir à la chasse aux antiquités avec Natasha Raskin et Phillip Serrell. C'est une bataille filles contre garçons, chaque équipe disposant de 400 £. Le voyage commence à Wormsley, dans le Herefordshire, puis les deux équipes se dirigent vers le pays de Galles et l'Oxfordshire, avant de finir à North Finchley, à Londres, pour une vente aux enchères.En chemin, les filles rencontrent un fabricant de sabots qui sculpte les chaussures à la main. Pendant ce temps, les garçons se rendent au Herefordshire Light Infantry Museum pour en apprendre davantage sur l’implication du régiment à Gallipoli.

programme.title: Masterpiece
programme.desc: A l'époque des fastes, Coorte passait des heures à travailler sur ses natures mortes austères composées d'une botte d'asperges, de trois pêches ou d'un bol de fraises. Comment se fait-il qu'il faille huit couleurs différentes pour approcher le blanc des asperges de Coorte ? Et pourquoi sont-elles si transparentes ? La recherche des réponses conduit l'équipe dans une petite église et chez un cultivateur d'asperges dans les provinces néerlandaises, ce qui conduit à une découverte spéciale dans un laboratoire de chimie.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: On the night of 17–18 October 1984, three criminals broke into the municipal museum in Semur-en-Auxois, which was not fitted with an alarm system. The joint investigation by the French and Japanese police revealed links between the Parisian underworld and the Japanese Yakuza mafia. Indeed, Shinchi Fujikuma, a Japanese gangster, had met two members of the Aubervilliers gang, Philippe-Emile Jamin and Youssef Khimoun, whilst serving time in a French prison. In 1987, the French managed to return from Japan with four of the five stolen paintings. The last one, *The Portrait of Mrs Baudot*, remained with its new owner, in accordance with the principle of ‘good faith’ guaranteed by Japanese law.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: Painted by the Van Eyck brothers, ‘The Adoration of the Mystical Lamb’ or ‘The Ghent Altarpiece’ is regarded as one of the greatest masterpieces of the Flemish Primitives. Installed in St Bavon’s Cathedral in Ghent as early as 1432, it escaped theft and looting on several occasions, However, on the night of 10–11 April 1934, two panels were stolen, one of which – ‘The Just Judges’ – has never been recovered to this day, because the bishop refused to pay the ransom demanded….

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.sub-title: The 5 Masterpieces of the Museum of Modern Art – Paris
programme.desc: In 2010, five masterpieces by Picasso, Matisse, Braque, Modigliani and Léger went missing. A year into the investigation, the police arrested the burglar, Vrejan Tomic. A repeat offender, with 11 art thefts to his name, he usually works to order. In this case, the client was Jean-Michel Corvez. Wrapped in bin bags, these unsellable works were found at the home of a third man, Yonathan Birn. How? Why?

programme.title: China - Masters of the Arts
programme.sub-title: Yan Gongda - The Art of Calligraphy
programme.desc: While the hieroglyphs of Egypt and the cuneiform of Babylon have disappeared, Chinese calligraphy, also graphic and non-alphabetic, has endured through the ages. Of divinatory origin, Chinese characters carry not only a language but a unique way of thinking. A 84th-generation descendant of one of Confucius’s best-known disciples, calligrapher Yan Gongda unrolls before our camera the timeless story of a writing art closer to painting than graphology. Through this story, the entire history of China is told.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: British Museum is a museum of human history and culture, located in London, United Kingdom. It contains over seven million of the world's most important objects.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Il y a une grande simplicité et un réalisme troublant dans les figures du peintre lorrain Georges de La Tour (1593-1652). Marqué par les œuvres du Caravage, il a produit des œuvres aux tonalités claires, comme la fameuse composition du Tricheur à l’as de carreau, mais aussi de nombreuses scènes nocturnes, au clair-obscur saisissant, simplement éclairées par la lumière d’une chandelle, comme dans Le nouveau-né ou l’Adoration des bergers actuellement conservé au Louvre à Paris.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: In the late 18th century (between 1775 and 1779), Claude Nicolas Ledoux built a monumental factory for the King of France in Franche-Comté. A revolution in architecture, a decade before the full-blown Revolution. Ledoux wanted to reinvent architecture, just as Rousseau wanted to reinvent the Social Contract, by returning to the sources, to "natural principles". It was both an aesthetic revolution, an innovative industrial site and the nucleus of an ideal city that would never see the light of day.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: It’s a journey into antiquity with glamorous historians Suzannah Lipscomb and Kate Williams. Paired with experts David Harper and Catherine Southon they Road Trip from Bletchley in Buckinghamshire to an auction in London. There’s also opportunity to hear how Mrs Beeton became the first ‘domestic Goddess’ and why Luton played a critical role in the fashion world when hats were de rigueur daily wear. David and Suzannah gamble on a giant ant while Catherine and Kate plump for a very large tea urn.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In each episode of Photo Contest, two contestants compete on an imposed theme such as rock'n roll, Japan or architecture. They have one hour to take the best possible photographs before editing them for 30 minutes in a studio. The photographs they have selected are then presented to Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, who will have to choose the best photographer.

programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Prussian painter, Caspar David Friedrich. You will discover his labour with The Wanderer above the mists, Greifswald port or the Lone tree.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Spanish painter, Francisco de Goya. You will discover his labour with Lunch in the Countryside, The third of may 1808 or the Cannibals.

programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The National Gallery in London is one of the world’s greatest art galleries. It is brimming with masterpieces, an inexhaustible treasure trove of history and an endless source of stories. This film gives a voice to those whose lives have been touched by the Gallery, from the security guard to the director, including daily visitors, celebrities and members of the royal family. Claudia Winkleman, Michael Palin, Terry Gilliam, Jacqueline Wilson and Her Royal Highness Princess Eugenie reveal their deeply personal connection to the National Gallery.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: William Blake (1757-1827) developed his own complex and personal mythology. He was a pre-romantic British painter, engraver and poet.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Established as a pictorial genre in its own right during the Renaissance, the female nude became one of the most important subjects in European painting. Under pretexts both mythological (Titian’s “Venus of Urbino”) and biblical (Rembrandt’s “Bathsheba at her Bath”) or Oriental (Ingres’“Great Odalisque”), the female body was unveiled. These pretexts vanish with Manet’s “Olympia”, a simple portrayal of a contemporary woman naked, which resulted in scandal.Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Joyau de géométrie et de rigueur, cette bibliothèque est l'un des derniers chefs-d'œuvre de Louis Kahn. En disposant les lecteurs sur la périphérie du bâtiment, près de la lumière du jour, et en créant un immense hall central, Louis Kahn réinvente le plan de la bibliothèque. Achevée en 1971 dans la petite ville d'Exeter, dans l'État américain du New Hampshire, la bibliothèque de l'Exeter Academy forme un mystérieux monolithe de brique aux 4 façades identiques sur 8 étages.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Vermeer and music - the art of love and leisure
programme.desc: La National Gallery de Londres propose un nouveau regard sur l'un des plus grands artistes de tous les temps, Johannes Vermeer. Il est le peintre de la célèbre toile “La Jeune Fille à la perle”. Dans une exposition intitulée "Vermeer et la musique : L'art de l'amour et des loisirs

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Pablo Picasso est l’un des plus grands artistes au monde, et jusqu’à sa mort en 1973, il était le plus prolifique. Comment tout a commencé ? Comment s’est construit Picasso ? Après avoir été trop longtemps ignorées, il est temps de se concentrer sur les jeunes années de l’artiste et son éducation qui lui ont permis d’accomplir l’extraordinaire. Trois villes ont joué un rôle-clé : Malaga, Barcelone et Paris. "Le jeune Picasso" les traverse et explore leur influence sur l’artiste, en analysant des œuvres spécifiques de ses débuts.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: An emblematic figure in Europe at the turn of the 18th century, this corporal who became Emperor of France unleashed the imagination of artists from whom he commissioned many works. Discover the victorious young “Bonaparte at the Pont d’Arcole” immortalised by the Antoine-Jean Gros in 1796. Observe also the portraits of all the guests present during the “Coronation of Napoleon” and his triumphant gesture as he crowned his wife Josephine in David’s masterpiece displayed in the Louvre Museum. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Rediscover the paintings of Jacob Jordaens. This artist is the subject of a special exhibition at the Petit Palais in 2013-1014.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Comedy legend Jennifer Saunders and best pal, top actress Patricia Potter take to the road on a humdinger of a trip. Joined by veteran antiquers Phillip Serrell and Mark Stacey they shop in Berkshire, Hampshire and Oxfordshire before heading for an auction in Greenwich, London. Jennifer and Phil detour to hear about Fred Karno, the man credited with inventing slapstick comedy. While Patricia and Mark learn how a surgeon from Reading used his incredible sense of smell to successfully treat soldiers injured in World War One.And, Phil gets custard pied – what’s not to love?

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Rembrandt at the National Gallery, London & Rijksmuseum, Amsterdam
programme.desc: Every Rembrandt exhibition is eagerly awaited, but this exhibition organized by London's National Gallery and Amsterdam's Rijksmuseum was an unprecedented event. The documentary highlights the historic Rembrandt exhibition, while tracing his life. Rembrandt is one of the greatest artists who ever lived, and this deeply moving documentary seeks to explore the truth about the man behind the legend.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Without Camille Pissarro, there is no Impressionist movement. He is rightfully known as the father of Impressionism.It was a dramatic path that Pissarro followed, and throughout it all he wrote extensively to his family. It is through these intimate and revealing letters that this gripping film reveals Pissarro’s life and work.Born in the West Indies, Pissarro found his passion in paint as a young man in Paris, and by the age of 43 had corralled a group of enthusiastic artists into a new collective. Their first show was scorned by the critics, but the group had acquired a new name: the Impressionists. For the next 40 years Pissarro was the driving force behind what has today become the world’s favourite artistic movement.The Ashmolean Museum has a long tradition of excellence. As the UK’s first ever public museum (it opened its doors in May 1683) it houses a wonderfully rich collection, including the remarkable Pissarro archive. With exclusive access to most extensive archive of.

programme.title: The decisive moment
programme.desc: In this episode, we will meet Zakaria Abdelkafi, photojournalist. He is Syrian, correspondent for the French news agency in Aleppo from 2013 to 2015, and he is now based in Paris because, after a report in Turkey, he was unable to return to his country. He will tell us his story and how he became a photographer.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Deux amies de la scène et de la télévision, Ruth Madoc et Su Pollard, connues pour leurs apparitions dans la sitcom Hi-De-Hi, partent à la chasse aux antiquités avec Phil Serrell et Raj Bisram. Partis de Monmouth, ville frontalière du Pays de Galles, ils se rendent à Congleton, dans le Cheshire, pour une vente aux enchères.Ruth découvre également l'incroyable infirmière du XIXe siècle - et ce n'est pas Florence Nightingale - tandis que Su visite l'ancienne ville romaine de Caerleon et trouve le temps d'affronter Phil dans un amphithéâtre.Et Su tente de résoudre un vieux mystère... Phil porte-t-il une perruque ?

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Deux stars des années 70, le crooner cool Tony Christie et la royauté pop Jimmy Osmond, sont accompagnés des experts Catherine Southon et Margie Cooper. Partant de la ville de Loughborough, dans le Leicestershire, ils se dirigent vers une vente aux enchères à Stoke-on-Trent, dans le Staffordshire.Tony profite d'une visite à Coalbrookdale, le lieu où des techniques innovantes ont été développées, marquant le début de la révolution industrielle. De son côté, le passionné de voitures Jimmy s'offre un tour sur le circuit historique de Donington.La grande finale aux enchères comprend un moment de chant en groupe unique en son genre. Mais quel maestro musical remportera la victoire ?

programme.title: Masterpiece
programme.desc: En 1840, Turner a peint le chef-d'œuvre "Nuages et l'eau". Charlotte tente de comprendre son style libre, avec des taches épaisses. L'Anglais et violoncelliste Dominic Seldis vient faire résonner son violoncelle pour vanter les mérites de ce "Rembrandt britannique". Michel découvre que le tableau a subi un traitement précaire, mais se demande comment. En quête de réponses, l'équipe se rend à la Tate Britain puis sur une falaise anglaise venteuse. Un épisode dans lequel un fer à repasser, un rocher de craie à Margate et un pot de cire d'abeille jouent un rôle prépondérant.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: 200 years after it opened and a century after acquiring its first Van Gogh works, the National Gallery hosted the largest Van Gogh exhibition ever held in the UK (September 14, 2024 to January 19, 2025). The exhibition was a huge success, unanimously praised by the press, and tickets sold out quickly, making this film the only way to see what Forbes called a “once-in-a-lifetime exhibition.”Discover the passion that drove one of the world's most beloved artists to revolutionize art. Van Gogh: Poets & Lovers rewrites history and celebrates Van Gogh's genius without exploiting his suffering, allowing audiences to truly understand this iconic artist in a whole new way...

programme.title: Van Gogh: The Real Story
programme.desc: Perhaps the most well-known fact about Vincent's troubled life is that he cuts his ear. Dive into the horrifying story of what it is that inspires him to do something so drastic.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Cette exposition très attendue à la Royal Academy of Arts était la toute première rétrospective consacrée au portrait d'Édouard Manet. Couvrant l'ensemble de la carrière de cet artiste énigmatique et parfois controversé, l'exposition a rassemblé des œuvres provenant d'Europe, d'Asie et des États-Unis. Le portrait de Manet n'a jamais fait l'objet d'une exposition, bien qu'il représente environ la moitié de sa production artistique. Il a peint sa famille, ses amis et les personnalités littéraires, politiques et artistiques de l'époque, donnant vie non seulement à ses sujets mais aussi à la société parisienne.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: During the Renaissance the male body was portrayed less frequently than its female counterpart. With the advent of studies at the French Academy in Rome, the male nude became, on the contrary, the most important exercise for the student painter, to the point where a work portraying a naked man became known as “Academy Study”. Look at the figure in “Charon Ferrying the Shades” by Subleyras or the “Male Nude or Hector” by David. The male nude also represents the heroic nude, for example in Ingres’ painting “Oedipus and the Sphinx”.Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: The building constructed in Berlin by Daniel Libeskind raises the question of architecture's own limits: How to build where everything has been destroyed without erasing the traces of what has disappeared? Today, this museum is one of the largest in Europe and offers a testament to two millennia of Jewish history in Germany. More than a museum, it is a tribute to the millions of victims of the Holocaust.

Mais avant de s'affronter chacun leur tour à coups de pinceaux et de clous, nos quatre décorateurs amateurs ont rendez-vous dans l’atelier. C’est l'occasion de jauger leurs adversaires. La première prétendante au titre d'As de la déco, c'est Céline, une Bruxelloise de 35 ans.

programme.title: Home training

This varied and dynamic program promises effective overall strengthening, with modifications tailored to each level.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, we're off to discover summer fruits, which are harvested from June to August: peaches, melons, strawberries, raspberries... We'll then head to the cherry capital, Céret, and cook blueberries, strawberries and an apricot charlotte.

programme.title: Yoga

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Auxerre is cut by valleys whose best exposed slopes are home to vineyards. The meandering course of the Yonne runs vertically through this region. To the east of Auxerre, the Chablis region is rounded with hills. The vineyard, extending on both sides of the valley of the Serein. To the south, lined by the Nivernais canal, the upper Yonne valley attracts climbing enthusiasts and boaters, before being swollen by the waters of the Cure. The region is renowned throughout the world for the quality of its wines, particularly those of Chablis. Julie begins her journey in Auxerre and then proposes typical recipes from the area: croquignoles and cherry clafoutis.

programme.title: Deco Masters
programme.desc: On this second day, we meet up with Mélissa, 30, originally from Montpellier. This administrative agent has been living in Montreal for five years. And decorating is in her blood. It's a heritage that Mélissa hopes will prove to be an asset in the competition. Listening is all very well. But this week, it's all about sticking to the theme “like a garden”. Will Mélissa be this week's ace decorator?

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie is offering you a trip to the south of France. Between the Rhone Valley and the Mediterranean, let's discover a fruit that is harvested in November: the olive.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Nous entamerons ce périple près de la Rochelle pour en apprendre un peu plus sur l’élevage des fameuses moules de bouchot mais aussi une technique bien particulière pour les cuisiner. Nous partirons ensuite pour un tour de France des meilleures huîtres : direction Cancale, Arcachon, Montpellier et enfin Oléron pour connaître les différentes méthodes d’élevage et s’y retrouver un peu plus parmi toutes les espèces de l’hexagone. Julie cuisinera une fricassée de berniques, les petits chapeaux chinois qui recouvrent les rochers du littoral mais aussi des palourdes roses méconnues du grand public. Nous poursuivrons notre route dans le Finistère pour rencontrer Sylvain, le seul éleveur d’ormeau du pays puis à Méru où se trouve encore des ateliers magnifiant ce sublime matériau. Le Chef Jean-Marie Baudic nous cuisine les coquilles Saint-Jacques comme personne.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us down a different kind of yellow-brick road, one that tastes of childhood and gourmet delights: the road of sweets. France may be famous for its gastronomy, but it's not to be outdone when it comes to pastries and confectionery - quite the opposite. “Bêtises” from Cambrai, "Berlingots” from Carpentras, "Calissons” from Aix-en-provence, every region in France has its own sweet or confectionery.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dans cette épisode, Luana Belmondo reçoit son amie Suzie Palatin pour préparer de la cuisine antillaise. Au menu : colombo de poulet, en en dessert, un blanc-manger au coco.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: How can we reconcile the development needed to sustain the lives of nearly seven billion people with the protection of the Earth's natural resources? Yann Arthus-Bertrand and his team have chosen Gabon to continue their survey of the planet. We'll be discovering the Kongou Falls, the Langoué clearing with their elephant in Gabon. Then in Colombia, we will go on the island of Malpelo with their shark. Back to Gabon we will discover the Minkébé National Park and the bats in Franceville. We will also go to India in Hyderabad, which has convinced farmers to use no pesticides and no GMOs in their cultivation.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Honey was the first sweet condiment in history! It has also been known and consumed as a remedy since Antiquity. In France, we find an infinite variety of honey: acacia, chestnut, fir, rosemary, orange, spruce, oak, linden or lavender... We'll cross forests, fields and even towns, as bees also forage in urbanized areas. We'll then cook up emblematic recipes like Vercel gingerbread. Finally, we'll discover the European dark bee. Protecting this 80-million-year-old bee has become the spearhead of some passionate beekeepers.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Les Héros de la Nature : Sénégal - Partie 2
programme.desc: For this new episode, Yann Arthus-Bertrand travels through Senegal to encounter men and women who dedicate their lives to preserving the environment. One of the major ecological stakes of the country is fishing and the mangrove ecosystem which, like in some many other parts of the world, faces major threats. Yann Arthus-Bertrand presents the struggle of Haidar El Ali, chosen among one of the world’s most active ecologists. He creates protected marine areas and reforests the disappeared mangrove of his country. He’s managed to convince thousands of Senegalese to plant with him ten million mangrove trees.

Dans cette partie du Mali où il ne pleut quasiment jamais. En Palestine, le village de Wadi Fukeen. Un village où les agriculteurs utilisent un système d’irrigation et de partage de l’eau vieux de plus de 300 ans et basé sur le respect et la confiance. Et en Palestine à Gaza où les spécialistes se battent pour sauver des enfants palestiniens rendus malades par de l’eau impropre à la consommation. Dans la Vallée du Jourdain où trois pays en conflit affrontent les mêmes problèmes : le manque d’eau. programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Aujourd’hui, les plus gourmands ne devraient pas être déçus puisque c’est le chocolat qui est mis à l’honneur. Découvert par les mayas il y 2500 ans et plus largement ensuite par les Aztèques, le chocolat fait partie aujourd’hui des produits préférés des français. Et qu’on ne s’y trompe pas : au même titre que la cuisine a ses grands chef, le chocolat a aussi ses grands chocolatiers. Coté recettes, Julie fera découvrir un gâteau qu’on ne fait qu’à Saint Émilien et qui associe le chocolat au macaron, avant de rejoindre le Pays Basque pour un dessert qui ne manque pas de piment. Nous grimperons ensuite en montagne à la rencontre d’une cuisinière d’origine suisse qui fait des pains au chocolat à sa façon. Enfin, vous verrez que le chocolat nous réserve de nombreuses surprises : il possède de nombreuses vertus et s’utilise aussi pour le bien être.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Tendre et savoureux, l’agneau tient une place prépondérante dans la cuisine festive mais aussi dans celle de tous les jours. Du Pays Basque au Cotentin en passant par Paris, Julie part donc sur les routes de France à la découverte des différentes races et types d'élevage existant à travers le pays. Il faut dire que la France a l'une des productions les plus variées au monde. Il existe plus d'une quarantaine de races répertoriées en 5 catégories : précoces, d’herbage, rustiques, mérinos et laitières. Mais plus qu’à la race, c’est à la façon dont ils sont alimentés qui intéresse les fins connaisseurs. Julie nous fait découvrir ses producteurs et cuisiniers de ce met raffiné !

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, Luana Belmondo cuisine des pois chiches. Comme ils sont originaires du Moyen-Orient, elle décide de préparer des recettes libanaises. Au menu : fallafels avec des pois chiches, du kumquat, des épices, de la cannelle, et blettes aux pois chiches, persil, menthe et boulgour.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, Luana Belmondo met la Normandie à l'honneur ! Avec le président de la région, Hervé Morin, elle prépare des pommes pochées dans un sirop de cannelle, ainsi que des moules... à sa façon.

From Collonges-la-Rouge, a flamboyant red sandstone town, to the Cistercian abbey of Aubazine, and through Beaulieu-sur-Dordogne and its medieval heritage, each place bears witness to a rich past. But beyond its monuments, this region is also seductive for its untouched nature and its passionate inhabitants, guardians of an age-old legacy.

Guillaume and Sabrina introduce the superset method, which involves working antagonist muscles like the quadriceps and glutes. This approach alternates between an active muscle and a passive muscle, increasing the intensity of the exercises. programme.title: Deco Masters
programme.desc: Today, it's 26-year-old Aurélie who's throwing herself into the ring. Originally from Nice, France, she has been passionate about decorating since she was a little girl. She decided to leave her job as a window dresser to go back to school to study decoration. In life as in decorating, Aurélie knows where to go. In fact, she already has definite ideas about this week's theme, "urban jungle".

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: This week, it is 80 kms from the capital, in Fontainebleau, that Julie is putting down her bags. Fontainebleau, a name famous throughout the world, a magical name which evokes for some a forest, for others a castle, a name which still shines with its royal history. The forest of Fontainebleau has inspired the art world since the beginning of the 19th century. Landscape painters such as Corot and Millet drew inspiration for their works there. But Fontainebleau has many other treasures in its bag, and gastronomy is part of its heritage. This is what Julie will discover through three recipes: Quail with grapes, raspberry and poppy pie and crayfish grave.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: C'est à Giverny que démarre le voyage de Julie, celui dont le nom résonne immédiatement comme le berceau de l’Impressionnisme a gardé une authenticité émouvante, Giverny impose son style, murmure son histoire. Sa notoriété est fortement liée à la présence historique de Claude Monet et à tous les fabuleux témoins laissés par ce dernier. Claude Monet a aussi laissé son empreinte dans la cuisine à Giverny. Ses carnets de recettes sont là pour en témoigner. C’est dans ces carnets que Julie va s’inspirer pour remplir le sien, au menu : Lapin en compote, feuilleté d’andouilles au camembert, et charlottes aux abricots.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie prend la direction de la Bourgogne pour découvrir des races anciennes de volaille réintroduites en France grâce au travail de l’éleveur Fred Ménager. Nous nous rapprocherons ensuite de l’Auvergne pour découvrir comment est attribué le fameux Label Rouge et le rôle des organismes certificateurs … car il est important de savoir ce qui atterri dans nos assiettes. Julie se rendra aussi dans la Drôme pour cuisiner de la pintade avant de se diriger vers le Périgord pour préparer un civet de dindon. Installée dans sa petite Micheline, Julie remontera ensuite vers le centre pour découvrir un étonnant fabricant de mouche qui utilise des plumes de coqs !

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Si l’été est la saison où les légumes abondent au potager, il serait dommage de ne pas savourer ceux que les saisons plus fraîches nous offrent : potages, tourtes, potées ou gratins mettent à l’honneur des légumes de saisons, idéals pour se réchauffer. Pour débuter ce nouveau voyage, un légume qui trônait déjà sur les tables de la Grèce Antique : le salsifis que Julie cuisinera avec une drôle de tourtière…L’hiver c’est aussi la saison du chou alors direction la Champagne pour y apprendre la recette de la potée locale qui devrait remplir le ventre d’un grand nombre de convives.Ce petit tour de France nous emmènera aussi à la découverte d’orfèvres du maraîchage qui sculptent légumes et fruits d’hiver, et vous présentera différentes techniques et méthodes pour sublimer vos potagers.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie takes us on a journey of spices and aromatic plants. Spices are a call to travel, to faraway lands and to the unknown. On her journey, Julie will introduce us to the famous black pepper.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, le potiron est à l'honneur. Luana Belmondo cuisine un velouté de potiron aux épices avec des sablés salés au parmesan. Et pour la suite, elle prépare des gnocchis de potiron avec une sauce au fromage onctueuse.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, Luana Belmondo invite son amie Eleonora Galasso pour une pizza party ! Elles vont d'abord préparer une pâte maison. Ensuite, elles cuisineront une capriciosa avec des anchois, des câpres et du jambon, ainsi qu'une pizza fritta avec de l’origan et de la sauce tomate.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: The incredible diversity of flora and fauna, the fight against climate change, the balance between growth and sustainable development: these are all battles being fought on five continents. Yann Arthus-Bertrand takes us on this expedition. We're off to Gabon to discover the Ivindo National Park and Port-Gentil, then on to Sri Lanka in Kandi. Back to Gabon we go to Libreville, then Lambaréné to talk about turtles and the health of the local people. Finally, off to Dhaka-Bangladesh.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: Canada is the second largest country in the world by land mass and contains amazing natural resources: 7% of the Earth’s drinking water is spread over the country’s thousands of lakes. Forests cover 45% of the territory. Yann Arthus-Bertrand goes off to discover these resources with those whose job it is to protect them. He takes a look at the ecological balance sheet of the world’s eighth-largest economic power.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Défendre l’eau c’est défendre la vie - Partie 1
programme.desc: The oceans cover more than 70% of the Earth's surface. The sea is the largest natural environment on our planet and remains virtually unexploited. In Brittany, in the Seven Islands. Then in the Bay of Saint-Brieuc, in the middle of a sea of green algae. In Brittany, intensive agriculture has developed over the last thirty years. In New Caledonia, the coral reef is the second largest in the world and could be threatened by the construction of a nickel mine. In Normandy, in the Botanical Garden of Vauville, an extraordinary garden has plants from all over the world. Also in the Archipelago of Chausey in Normandy with the highest tides in Europe. Or the Mont Saint Michel. As a result of silting up and man-made works, the Mont was no longer an island. In Italy, in Venice, on the verge of drowning, major development work, industrialisation and tourism have upset the environment. In New Caledonia, flying over the heart of Voh is surrounded by the largest lagoon in the world. 24,000 km2 prot.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: C’est à nouveau sur les routes de France que l’on retrouve aujourd’hui Julie pour parler d’un produit incontournable des tables françaises : le fromage. Plus qu’un engouement gourmand, plus qu’une friandise de fins de repas, le fromage est associé à l’image de la gastronomie française, et d’ailleurs reconnu patrimoine immatériel par l’UNESCO. Les français ne s’y sont pas trompés : avec près de 1 000 variétés - des pâtes molles, aux pâtes cuites, persillées, ou encore pressées, et avec 45 Appellations, nous sommes les plus gros consommateurs de fromage au monde !

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie takes you through the Pyrénées Orientales, then Corsica, before making a stop on the Côte d'Azur, and concludes her journey between Rungis and Paris... all to explore the world of citrus fruits! These fruits add flavor, zest, and seasoning to any recipe, making them indispensable in the kitchen. They bring the warmth and sunshine of the South of France and the exoticism of distant lands. While we're all familiar with lemons, clementines, and grapefruits, Julie introduces us to a thousand other varieties.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes you on a bread trail to uncover the dedicated artisan bakers and millers. Her adventure will lead her through the Libourne region, then onwards to the North of France, the Ardèche, and the Aisne, where bakers have transformed bread into a powerful catalyst for social cohesion. While some individuals may avoid bread, particularly due to gluten-related concerns, others have chosen to reposition it at the forefront of the dining experience by championing its nutritional benefits. This commitment is shared by several chefs whom Julie will meet at the conclusion of her expedition.

programme.title: South America's Weirdest Animals

programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Sommeren byr på overflod, men i kappløpet om å utnytte den korte varme årstiden følger også konkurranse, aggresjon og fare. Høyt oppe på fjellengene kjemper alpemurmeldyrene om de beste hiene der de kan oppfostre ungene sine. Men klarer de å unnslippe sultne bjørner? Bjørnungene i Karpatene vokser raskt, men trues av voksne hannbjørner som vil kvitte seg med rivalenes avkom. Klarer binnene å beskytte dem med sine smarte strategier? Flokker av europeisk bison dundrer gjennom de gamle skogene på jakt etter mat og vann. De er et av de fremste eksemplene på vellykket reintroduksjon, fordi tråkkene deres skaper liv i hele skogen og gir gode vilkår for milliarder av insekter. Insektene søker videre til kronhjortflokkene etter næring. Plaget av stikkende insekter trekker hjortene opp i fjellene for å slippe dem, men der risikerer de i stedet å bli bytte for sjeldne villkatter.

programme.title: Dyrenes Fight Club
programme.desc: På planeten vår er det flere arter som kolliderer i naturens ville kamp for overlevelse. Fra elefanthanner som kjemper om en gruppe hunner, til en kamp mellom en løveflokk og en sulten hyene-klan, disse drapsmaskinene kjemper med tenner og klør for å vinne mat, territorier og retten til slektslinjen. Vær vitne til slåss-evnene til planetens mest fryktløse skapninger i det de kjemper for overlevelsen i de dødeligste konflikter.

programme.title: Lion
programme.sub-title: Chapter Two: A Band Of Brothers
programme.desc: Kio overlever mirakuløst et bøffelangrep, men utfordringene har så vidt begynt. Han er bare tolv uker gammel – den yngste og mest sårbare i flokken. Skal han en dag bli konge, må han vinne brødrenes respekt og finne sin plass. Akkurat da han endelig blir akseptert, slår tørken til, og det blir kamp om maten. Summer må derfor ta et drastisk valg for å sikre Kios fremtid.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Etter en desperat leting gjenforenes Kio og Summer med brødrene, men livet i utkanten av flokkens territorium er nådeløst. Summer sliter med å jakte for de uerfarne sønnene og forberede dem på et liv alene, og kampen for å overleve tærer på. Når et lett bytte blir for fristende, får det konsekvenser som forandrer Kios liv for alltid. Han tvinges til å bli selvstendig lenge før tiden, og nå må Kio og brødrene hans lære å overleve på egen hånd.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Kio og brødrene hans har kommet til en ny og farlig verden. Som den yngste er Kio den mest sårbare. Da de oppdager et frodig våtmarksområde med rikelig med byttedyr og en løvinneflokk, virker det som det perfekte nye hjemmet. Men dette paradiset har allerede sine konger. Et brutalt angrep splitter brødreflokken og tvinger Kio på flukt. Alene og forlatt er sjansene hans for å overleve små, men han finner mot til å rope og gjenforenes med brødrene. Sammen møter de en rekke prøvelser, fra bøffeljakt til kamper med rivaler, og knytter et ubrytelig bånd. Til slutt, som en selvsikker og nesten fullvoksen hannløve, vender Kio tilbake for å utfordre de gamle kongene. Seier sikrer ham et kongerike, en flokk og en ny familie. Nederlag betyr eksil. Vil Kio falle, eller vil han reise seg og endelig innta tronen?

programme.title: Lion Brothers: Cubs To Kings
programme.desc: Livet har andre planer, og stikker kjepper i hjulene for denne unge oppstarten. Kan Leo, med sin bror Max ved sin side, møte sine utfordringer og komme over egen arroganse for å bli den kongen han alltid har drømt om å skulle bli?

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Etter å ha hjulpet lokale ungdommer med å gjøre dyrene klare til messen, vil veterinærene fortsatt hjelpe til. Dr. Pol behandler en geit som fikk revet opp øret, mens dr. Lisa undersøker en halt ku. På klinikken gjør dr. Nicole alt for å redde livet til en hund.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Utstyrt med en bøtte og en slange prøver dr. Pol å hjelpe en hest som ikke får puste. På klinikken tar dr. Lisa imot en katt med flere lidelser, mens dr. Brenda behandler en annen katt. Da Charles blir bekymret for hunden sin, ber han faren om råd.

programme.title: Kinas skjulte kongeriker
programme.desc: I Kinas skoger, jungler og høye fjell lever noen av verdens mest besynderlige og vakreste skapninger. I disse skjulte rikene krever kampen for å overleve ofte helt unike tilpasninger. En ung panda får sin første klatreundervisning, fargerike larver viser fram sine iøynefallende mønster, og verdens eneste giftige primat, dovenlorien, sniker seg til et lite måltid. De utrolige historiene gir et sjeldent innblikk i en bemerkelsesverdig verden.

programme.title: Wild Vietnam
programme.sub-title: Mysterious North: Land of Mountain Forests
programme.desc: Fra pangoliner, asiatiske palmesivetter og Delacours langurer til cat ba-langurer og de nylig oppdagede vitenamesiske krokodilleøglene. Vi ser på det utrolige utvalget av unike dyr som trives i de ekstreme forholdene som finnes i de skogkledde fjellene i Vietnam.

programme.title: Wild Vietnam
programme.desc: Fra gibbonaper, makaker, grønne havskilpadder og orientalske kloløse dvergotere til kragebjørner, siamkrokodiller og asiagapenebb. Vi møter de bemerkelsesverdige dyrene som har tilpasset seg et liv i de unikt tøffe forholdene og ekstreme klimaene i det sørlige Vietnams tropiske habitater.

programme.title: Kinas skjulte kongeriker
programme.desc: I Kinas skoger, jungler og høye fjell lever noen av verdens mest besynderlige og vakreste skapninger. I disse skjulte rikene krever kampen for å overleve ofte helt unike tilpasninger. programme.title: Lion
programme.sub-title: Chapter Two: A Band Of Brothers
programme.desc: Kio overlever mirakuløst et bøffelangrep, men utfordringene har så vidt begynt. Han er bare tolv uker gammel – den yngste og mest sårbare i flokken. Skal han en dag bli konge, må han vinne brødrenes respekt og finne sin plass. Akkurat da han endelig blir akseptert, slår tørken til, og det blir kamp om maten. Summer må derfor ta et drastisk valg for å sikre Kios fremtid.

programme.title: Kinas skjulte kongeriker
programme.desc: I Kinas skoger, jungler og høye fjell lever noen av verdens mest besynderlige og vakreste skapninger. I disse skjulte rikene krever kampen for å overleve ofte helt unike tilpasninger. programme.title: Lion
programme.sub-title: Chapter One: A Prince Is Born
programme.desc: Den forsiktige løveungen Kio er sønnen til Summer, dronningen av en mektig flokk. Han blir født inn i en verden der hver lærdom har en pris. En dag skal han kanskje herske over sitt eget rike, men først må han lære å overleve. En tragisk bøffeljakt gir ham et første innblikk i hvor uforutsigbart livet på savannen er. Han blir stadig modigere, og hver utfordring tar ham lenger bort fra flokkens trygghet – helt til et eventyr på egen hånd fører ham rett i veien for flokkens største fiende: bøflene.

programme.title: De merkeligste
programme.desc: I verdens våteste arena må man være med på leken, og eneste premie er overlevelse. Bjørner utnytter andres styrke, en hai har en identitetskrise, en reke bruker sine skjulte krefter, en blekksprut lurer fienden, en liten fisk er egentlig en svindler, og en havslange svelger en fiende som er dobbelt så stor som den selv.

programme.title: De merkeligste
programme.desc: Dypt nede i det ville havet havner planetens merkeligste mutanter i masser av trøbbel. En blekksprut har en kokosnøttfetish, en krabbe ses naken, tiden er ute for en annen blekksprut, en reke beviser at styrke ikke handler om størrelse, en albatross bytter frihet mot sex og en fisk blir veldig, veldig sint.

programme.title: Borneos hemmelige rike: Vilt og sprøtt
programme.desc: Ved Kinabatangan-elva finner man store kontraster. Her bor det elefanter, krokodiller, orangutanger og hornfugler.
